latest_release.name: Wails v3.1.0
latest_release.body:
## Wails v3 Weekly Release - v3.1.0

## Added
- add experimental CGO-free macOS and Linux backends in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6521) by @taliesin-ai
- native YAML builds, portable packaging and signing in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6531) by @taliesin-ai

## Changed
- avoid copying discarded desktop metadata in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6391) by @taliesin-ai
- format content lengths without fmt in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6393) by @taliesin-ai
- select index roots without collecting candidates in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6404) by @taliesin-ai
- reuse non-seekable file copy buffers in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6408) by @taliesin-ai
- avoid allocating a reader for sniffing prefixes in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6410) by @taliesin-ai
- skip MIME sniff reads for known extensions in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6414) by @taliesin-ai
- prevent queue growth and shrink oscillation in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6415) by @taliesin-ai
- avoid allocating discarded request contexts in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6419) by @taliesin-ai
- skip disabled debug log preparation in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6420) by @taliesin-ai
- allocate MIME sniff buffers lazily in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6428) by @taliesin-ai
- reduce hyperlink formatting allocations in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6443) by @taliesin-ai
- remove temporary bullet formatting allocations in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6449) by @taliesin-ai
- reduce UUID string conversion to one allocation in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6453) by @taliesin-ai
- reduce statement-handle formatting allocations in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6454) by @taliesin-ai
- eliminate temporary name-based UUID digest allocation in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6455) by @taliesin-ai
- avoid copying unfinished command-output lines in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6460) by @taliesin-ai
- stream executable copies during package staging in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6472) by @taliesin-ai
- avoid rescanning unfinished output lines in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6473) by @taliesin-ai
- reuse compiled command routing patterns in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6475) by @taliesin-ai
- avoid metadata lookups during runtime discovery in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6482) by @taliesin-ai
- reduce localized fallback page allocations in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6485) by @taliesin-ai
- avoid recompiling patterns for each processor in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6490) by @taliesin-ai

## Fixed
- implement SetTooltip for the system tray in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6017) by @fan711
- read dark mode from the settings portal in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6072) by @TechHutTV
- let Window.SetZoom go below 1.0 in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6166) by @APshenkin
- deliver to each Go listener in emit order in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6275) by @DevLumuz
- read event hooks under hookLock in Emit in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6276) by @DevLumuz
- always advertise the tray Menu property so a tray created after Run is not dropped in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6284) by @AlbinoGeek
- hold main-thread work sent before Run until Run starts in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6287) by @AlbinoGeek
- use correct asset url in github updater provider in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6304) by @gavidroselj
- keep request body when WebView2 omits Content-Length in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/6326) by @strraaa
- report macOS and GTK screens in DIP space (mixed-DPI bounds) in [PR](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/pull/634

Build desktop applications using Go & Web Technologies.


[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-Hans.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [Português](README.pt-br.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [Francais](README.fr.md) · [Uzbek](README.uz.md) · [Deutsch](README.de.md) · [Türkçe](README.tr.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README.id.md)
## Table of Contents - [Table of Contents](#table-of-contents) - [Introduction](#introduction) - [Features](#features) - [Roadmap](#roadmap) - [Getting Started](#getting-started) - [Sponsors](#sponsors) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Stargazers over time](#stargazers-over-time) - [Contributors](#contributors) - [License](#license) - [Inspiration](#inspiration) ## Introduction The traditional method of providing web interfaces to Go programs is via a built-in web server. Wails offers a different approach: it provides the ability to wrap both Go code and a web frontend into a single binary. Tools are provided to make this easy for you by handling project creation, compilation and bundling. All you have to do is get creative! ## Features - Use standard Go for the backend - Use any frontend technology you are already familiar with to build your UI - Quickly create rich frontends for your Go programs using pre-built templates - Easily call Go methods from Javascript - Auto-generated Typescript definitions for your Go structs and methods - Native Dialogs & Menus - Native Dark / Light mode support - Supports modern translucency and "frosted window" effects - Unified eventing system between Go and Javascript - Powerful cli tool to quickly generate and build your projects - Multiplatform - Uses native rendering engines - _no embedded browser_! ### Roadmap The project roadmap may be found [here](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/discussions/1484). New functionality and public behaviour changes use a [WEP (Wails Enhancement Proposal)](v3/wep/README.md), submitted as a draft pull request rather than a feature-request issue. ## Getting Started Wails has two active versions: | Version | Status | Install | Docs | |---|---|---|---| | v2 | Stable | `go install github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/cmd/wails@latest` | [v2.wails.io](https://v2.wails.io/) | | v3.0.0 | Stable | `go install github.com/wailsapp/wails/v3/cmd/wails3@v3.0.0` | [wails.io](https://wails.io/) | Full installation instructions are available for [v2](https://v2.wails.io/docs/gettingstarted/installation) and [v3](https://wails.io). ## Sponsors This project is supported by these kind people / companies: ## Powered By [![JetBrains logo.](https://resources.jetbrains.com/storage/products/company/brand/logos/jetbrains.svg)](https://jb.gg/OpenSource) Thanks to [CodeRabbit](https://www.coderabbit.ai/oss) for supporting Wails with AI code reviews. ## FAQ - Is this an alternative to Electron? Depends on your requirements. It's designed to make it easy for Go programmers to make lightweight desktop applications or add a frontend to their existing applications. Wails does offer native elements such as menus and dialogs, so it could be considered a lightweight electron alternative. - Who is this project aimed at? Go programmers who want to bundle an HTML/JS/CSS frontend with their applications, without resorting to creating a server and opening a browser to view it. - What's with the name? When I saw WebView, I thought "What I really want is tooling around building a WebView app, a bit like Rails is to Ruby". So initially it was a play on words (Webview on Rails). It just so happened to also be a homophone of the English name for the [Country](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wales) I am from. So it stuck. ## Stargazers over time ## Contributors To improve the v3 documentation, follow [Write documentation with M-Press](docs/mpress/content/contributing/documentation.md) for downloads, installation, preview and submitting a PR. The contributors list is getting too big for the readme! All the amazing people who have contributed to this project have their own page [here](https://wails.io/credits/). ## License [![FOSSA Status](https://app.fossa.com/api/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fwailsapp%2Fwails.svg?type=large)](https://app.fossa.com/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2Fwailsapp%2Fwails?ref=badge_large) ## Inspiration This project was mainly coded to the following albums: - [Manic Street Preachers - Resistance Is Futile](https://open.spotify.com/album/1R2rsEUqXjIvAbzM0yHrxA) - [Manic Street Preachers - This Is My Truth, Tell Me Yours](https://open.spotify.com/album/4VzCL9kjhgGQeKCiojK1YN) - [The Midnight - Endless Summer](https://open.spotify.com/album/4Krg8zvprquh7TVn9OxZn8) - [Gary Newman - Savage (Songs from a Broken World)](https://open.spotify.com/album/3kMfsD07Q32HRWKRrpcexr) - [Steve Vai - Passion & Warfare](https://open.spotify.com/album/0oL0OhrE2rYVns4IGj8h2m) - [Ben Howard - Every Kingdom](https://open.spotify.com/album/1nJsbWm3Yy2DW1KIc1OKle) - [Ben Howard - Noonday Dream](https://open.spotify.com/album/6astw05cTiXEc2OvyByaPs) - [Adwaith - Melyn](https://open.spotify.com/album/2vBE40Rp60tl7rNqIZjaXM) - [Gwidaith Hen Fran - Cedors Hen Wrach](https://open.spotify.com/album/3v2hrfNGINPLuDP0YDTOjm) - [Metallica - Metallica](https://open.spotify.com/album/2Kh43m04B1UkVcpcRa1Zug) - [Bloc Party - Silent Alarm](https://open.spotify.com/album/6SsIdN05HQg2GwYLfXuzLB) - [Maxthor - Another World](https://open.spotify.com/album/3tklE2Fgw1hCIUstIwPBJF) - [Alun Tan Lan - Y Distawrwydd](https://open.spotify.com/album/0c32OywcLpdJCWWMC6vB8v)
